name: backlog
description: Monitors and maintains backlog health. Surfaces stale issues and blocked work so the queue stays actionable.

issues.title: Create roadmap and generate initial backlog
issues.description: Review the company goal, create a ROADMAP.md with milestones, then prepare only the next 3-5 acceptance-ready issues. Default delivery WIP is at most two open implementation PRs per repository and one active implementation issue per delivery agent. Assign only the next work that fits owner and review capacity; keep later roadmap items prioritized but inactive. Scope each issue to one deliverable, link it to the relevant goal/project, and give every implementation issue (including subissues) an isolated workspace unless explicit same-change reuse is required.

routines.title: Backlog grooming
routines.description: Routine-run checklist: inspect roadmap plus implementation/review capacity, keep repositories within the default two-PR WIP cap, create at most the next 1-3 scoped issues only when capacity is free, assign only work that has an available owner and review path, link artifacts/goals/projects, summarize WIP evidence and changes on the routine issue, then exit.
